title: params of tickets.submit
description: Write tickets from a FINALIZED, human-concurred review, through templates (api/v1/tickets/<template>.schema.json), through the kit's reconciler. One template per call. Every item is validated against its template before anything is read from the tracker; the review record must be finalized with a human concurrence bound to this exact evidence set (API_REVIEW_NOT_FINALIZED otherwise); every ticket in the tracker -- manual ones included -- is searched before anything is created, and a candidate match is surfaced for a person, never merged unless exact. KDEC-037 (amending KDEC-035 O-35f and O-35g).

review_id.description: The finalized review whose concurrence authorises this write (.security/reviews/<review_id>.json on the default branch). Required for every template except a closure verified by a kit scan.

link_decisions.description: A person's decisions on candidate matches a dry run surfaced: link this finding to that existing ticket, or open a new one. Part of the evidence set the review concurred with.

via.description: KDEC-043 (PROPOSED): the integration that submits this call (e.g. tines), written on each new ticket as the label <stamp>-via-<name>. A CLAIM, never proof: the kit compares it with the identity its credential authenticated as and the tracker's record of who made the write (KIT_INTEGRATION_IDENTITIES maps a name to that identity); a mismatch is flagged on the ticket and sent to a person.
